repairs.before: Strongest feature: Ward correctly observes that a causal account of agency detection does not by itself entail universal falsity and notes that Justin Barrett’s Christian commitment shows the mechanism’s originator did not accept Law’s atheistic conclusion, directly engaging the announced challenge. Principal limitation: proposing that God probably installed the detector presupposes the disputed deity and supplies no reliability evidence, while the existence of many false detections is not answered by mere compatibility with occasional truth; the garbled ending also weakens precision despite confirmed attribution. Live burden: Ward must establish truth-tracking rates or independent corroboration without using theism to validate evidence offered for theism. Locked score: 57 reflects recognizable contact and a valid warning against automatic causal debunking, but circular support, weak warrant, limited clarity, and inadequate engagement with Law’s actual unreliability defeater substantially depress every central dimension.
repairs.after: Strongest feature: Ward notes that a causal account of agency detection does not entail universal falsity, and his appeal to Justin Barrett’s Christianity challenges the claim that the mechanism automatically supports atheism. Principal limitation: saying God probably installed the detector presupposes the disputed deity, offers no reliability evidence, and leaves Law’s point about frequent false detections unanswered; the garbled closing words make Ward’s proposed truth-tracking scope uncertain. Live burden: Ward must provide non-circular corroboration, specify when this hyperactive detector registers genuine divine agency, and explain why its false-positive tendency does not defeat his own transcendent experiences. Locked score: 57 preserves credit for relevant contact and the valid compatibility warning, while weak warrant, circular support, limited precision, and failure to confront Law’s probabilistic unreliability defeater keep the reply substantially below adequacy.
repairs.rationale: Compresses the critique to the contract maximum while retaining the source-specific Barrett reference, Ward’s compatibility reply, Law’s unreliability objection, the garbled-source qualification, the live evidential burden, and the locked score of 57.
